note: Checkpoint E0 baseline for the Plumline mathematical engine. Captures the pre-E state as INVENTORY ONLY: hashes, sizes, contracts, function/constant maps and the two-source architecture finding. It is NOT regenerated during verify; tests_engine_baseline.js pins the values below. E0 changes NO engine byte, NO public output, NO Worker payload. See provenance for the origin of each group.

constants_tolerances.note: Identical in solver.html inline engine AND engine/engine.js. Values frozen; E0 changes none.
constants_tolerances.plot_geometry_tolerances_are_separate: ANGULAR_EPS / geometryEpsilon_ live in receipt-plot-exports.js (D4 visualization) and DO NOT affect the solver result; they are NOT engine tolerances

second_source.role: Node-requireable twin of the Google Sheets add-on engine (Engine.gs). Reads a Sheets-like sheet object (getDataRange/getFormulas/getValues) and exposes module.exports for tests.

relation_to_inline_engine.newContext_: inline forces allowCachedFormulaFallback:false (web grid stores 0 for formulas); engine.js parameterises it via options (Sheets cached value is exact). Same maths, different platform fallback policy.
relation_to_inline_engine.readConstraint_: identical logic; only inline comments differ

direct_execution.engine_source: the inline engine functions in the same lexical scope (detectModel_, solveModel_ called directly)
direct_execution.fallback: solveMainThread() runs the SAME inline functions on the main thread when Worker/Blob/URL unavailable

worker_execution.engine_source_acquisition: engineSource() scans document <script> textContent for the ENGINE_START..END slice (same slice convention)
worker_execution.object_url: URL.createObjectURL then revokeObjectURL after Worker constructed
worker_execution.token_correlation: workerToken increments per solve; stale responses (token mismatch) ignored
worker_execution.worker_uses: the SAME inline engine bytes (engineSource == canonical engine sha), NOT engine.js

stop_reasons: and status-derived limit normalisation in solveDetailsHTML
architecture_finding: Conclusion B+C+D combined: there is ONE canonical PRODUCTION engine (the solver.html inline region; direct + Worker consume exactly the same bytes, engineSource sha == canonical sha). But a SECOND real source exists: engine/engine.js, the Google Sheets add-on twin, 87/89 function bodies byte-identical after comment/whitespace normalisation, 2 divergent by platform policy only. The production contract is coupled to solver.html (Worker slices the page's own script). No math duplication inside production; the duplication is production-inline vs add-on-twin, kept in sync manually.

provenance.engine_canonical: captured from solver.html pre-E via the tests_engine_integrity slice convention
provenance.constants_tolerances: read from the inline ENGINE/APP objects and confirmed equal in engine.js
provenance.second_source: engine/engine.js pre-E; normalized-body comparison done in E0 analysis (comments stripped, whitespace collapsed)
provenance.worker_execution: glue reconstructed verbatim from engine/fragments/solver-ui/solve-worker-client.js; hashes computed over engineSource + glue
provenance.statuses_stop_reasons: enumerated from the inline engine and errors-results.js pre-E
provenance.do_not_regenerate: This fixture must NOT be rebuilt by any future engine implementation; tests_engine_baseline.js pins engine sha, glue sha, blob sha and the engine.js sha. Update only on a deliberate, reviewed baseline change.
